in_hebrew.name: Max
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Max הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Max is derived from the Latin word ‘Maximus’, meaning ‘the greatest’. This name was commonly given to emperors and leaders in the Roman Empire, signifying power, authority, and greatness. In Christianity, Max is also the short form of the name Maximilian, which means ‘greatest soldier’.
